description: This file contains functions and constants for normalizing, resolving, and reading configuration related to 'talk' providers, including API key handling, provider configuration normalization, and response building.

methods.name: isPlainObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a plain object (not null, not array).

methods.name: normalizeString
methods.description: Trims a string value and returns it if non-empty, otherwise undefined.

methods.name: normalizeVoiceAliases
methods.description: Normalizes voice alias mappings from an object.

methods.name: normalizeTalkSecretInput
methods.description: Normalizes API key input, handling strings and secret references.

methods.name: normalizeSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Validates and normalizes silence timeout value as a positive integer.

methods.name: normalizeTalkProviders
methods.description: Normalizes a set of talk providers from an object.

methods.name: legacyProviderConfigFromTalk
methods.description: Creates a legacy provider config from a source object.

methods.name: activeProviderFromTalk
methods.description: Determines the active provider ID from a TalkConfig object.

methods.name: normalizeTalkSection
methods.description: Normalizes a TalkConfig object, handling provider info and legacy formats.

methods.name: normalizeTalkConfig
methods.description: Normalizes the entire OpenClawConfig, focusing on the 'talk' section.

methods.name: resolveActiveTalkProviderConfig
methods.description: Resolves the active provider configuration from a TalkConfig.

methods.name: buildTalkConfigResponse
methods.description: Builds a response object from a TalkConfig, including resolved provider info.

methods.name: readTalkApiKeyFromProfile
methods.description: Reads the API key from user profile files.

methods.name: resolveTalkApiKey
methods.description: Resolves the API key from environment variables or profile files.
